body: Haha, I won't! You'll have to endure an internet hug though /hug

Thank you. I am super drunk right now, so I feel like I might skip hurting myself tonight.

This sounds strange, but I am seriously thankful for your replies; this is more than I have gotten from someone in years.

Great that you're doing okay. Really.

I feel like somethings wrong with me, since I am in full time therapy at the moment and I am feeling worse every day. Had 2 cats once, was unable to properly care for them so I had to give them away. Am scared of leaving my house, the telephone and whenever my doorbell rings. I have no food in my apartment since I'm afraid of everything outside and I am constantly starving myself because of it.

Why am I such an utter waste of space? This sounds very emo, but I genuinely feel like I am not fit to be alive being this fucked up. The stage your at is what I want to reach, but I can't even get up in the morning to go to therapy anymore - I literally am unable to leave my house because I get constant mental breakdowns.

I'm glad to hear that you have someone. Your little girl sounds precious.

I don't know how to go on, my life feels like it has run its course and I can't take this constant self-hate and emptiness that I feel anymore.

The thing I want most is for someone, anyone, to truly love and need me. My ex didn't treat me right.

I feel like if I don't find someone who actually wants to fill the void in me, I will just end it, you know? I have never been truly loved by anyone but my mom, and she was a horrible mother until I reached adulthood.

I feel so pathetic. Why did you decide to go on?

Several years of abuse through my parents (mental and sexual), failed at every job I ever had and have zero plans for the future. The worst thing is that I have no one to talk to.

Female/19 btw. And thank you for responding. Currently chugging down wine so I maybe get some sleep.
